---
name: project-discovery
description: Convert a fuzzy software idea into bounded scope, requirements, and decision-changing unknowns.
---
# Discovery and requirements

Determine problem, audience, user and product goals, constraints, assumptions, non-goals, dependencies, edge cases, and acceptance criteria. Inspect supplied context before asking only questions whose answers materially change scope. Give requirements stable `REQ-*` IDs.

Do not invent solution architecture or UI styling. Exit with a small scope artifact that another plugin can act on.
